sources.title: Ocrelizumab versus Interferon Beta-1a in Relapsing Multiple Sclerosis; Ocrelizumab versus Placebo in Primary Progressive Multiple Sclerosis
sources.notes: Phase III RCT; ocrelizumab effective in RRMS and PPMS; first DMT for PPMS. Paywall.

sources.title: Oligodendroglia metabolically support axons and contribute to neurodegeneration
sources.notes: MCT1 lactate pathway: OL metabolic support of axons is necessary for axon survival.

sources.title: A new mechanism of nervous system plasticity: activity-dependent myelination
sources.notes: Myelin sets conduction velocity for precise spike timing; activity-dependent myelination; white matter plasticity during learning.

sources.title: CRISPR-edited OPCs overcome chemorepellents for robust remyelination
sources.notes: CRISPR-engineered human ES-derived OPCs resistant to chemorepellents; enhanced remyelination in chronic MS model regardless of host age.

sources.title: Serum neurofilament light chain for individual prognostication of disease activity in people with multiple sclerosis
sources.notes: sNfL Z-score >1.5 predicts future disease activity; high-efficacy DMTs normalize sNfL. Paywall.

sources.title: Defining the clinical course of multiple sclerosis: the 2013 revisions
sources.notes: Updated MS clinical type classification (RRMS/SPMS/PPMS/CIS) with active/inactive modifier.

sources.title: Glymphatic function and white matter volume independently predict cognitive impairment in relapsing-remitting multiple sclerosis
sources.notes: ALPS index + white matter volume independently predict MS cognitive impairment; links MS to glymphatic system.

sources.title: Activity-dependent myelination: a glial mechanism of oscillatory self-organization in large-scale brain networks
sources.notes: Conduction delay statistics autonomously adjusted for efficient neural communication; MS-like damage disrupts synchronization homeostasis.

sources.title: Longitudinal analysis reveals high prevalence of Epstein-Barr virus associated with multiple sclerosis
sources.notes: EBV seroconversion precedes MS with 32-fold risk increase; strongest causal EBV-MS evidence. NOTE: PMID requires verification.
